'''Droog''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] purser who worked in [[Tassaa Bareesh]]'s palace on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[3643 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Shigar Konshi]] and [[Larin Moxla]] bribed him to allow them admission to the palace.
